transcript.t: Excuse me, I am looking for Red Square. Could you help me?
Of course. Take the metro to Okhotny Ryad station.
How many stops is that from here?
Only three. The ride takes about ten minutes.
Is the station near the Victory Museum?
No, the museum is in the west of the city. You can go there tomorrow.
Thank you. I'll go to Red Square first.
Have a good day, and enjoy your trip!
